title: Sr. Incorta Developer
description:
**Job Description:**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking an experienced Incorta Developer with 6–10 years of experience in enterprise reporting, analytics, and data modeling. The role will design scalable Incorta data models, develop complex dashboards and reports, integrate multiple source systems, and optimize analytical performance while partnering with business and data engineering teams.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Incorta Development and Data Modeling**

* Design and maintain Incorta physical schemas, business schemas, joins, materialized views, formula columns, measures, dimensions, and derived attributes.
* Configure ingestion jobs, data sources, pipelines, load plans, incremental refreshes, and data validation controls.
* Develop reusable semantic and dimensional models that support governed self\-service analytics.
* Translate complex business and reporting requirements into maintainable technical solutions.

**Reporting, Analytics, and Performance**

* Build complex operational, management, and executive dashboards and reports across multiple subject areas.
* Implement calculations, aggregations, filters, drilldowns, KPIs, exception reporting, and role\-based access.
* Troubleshoot and optimize queries, joins, formulas, schemas, ingestion patterns, and dashboard performance.
* Reconcile report outputs to source systems and resolve data quality or reporting discrepancies.

**Integration and Delivery**

* Integrate Incorta with ERP, CRM, WMS, TMS, finance, HR, and other enterprise source systems using database, API, file, or cloud\-based patterns.
* Work with data engineers on source mappings, transformations, data quality, refresh schedules, and lineage.
* Support design reviews, testing, UAT, defect resolution, releases, production support, and technical documentation.
* Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior developers and report developers.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* 6–10 years in business intelligence, enterprise reporting, data analytics, or data warehousing, including substantial Incorta development experience.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Incorta schemas, ingestion, Analyzer, dashboards, security, materialized views, and performance tuning.
* Advanced SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and performance\-aware query design.
* Strong understanding of semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data pipelines, source\-to\-target mappings, incremental loads, data profiling, and data governance.
* Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar databases; familiarity with APIs, JSON/XML, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder\-management, and documentation skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Incorta certification or formal training; experience with Incorta Cloud.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Cognos, or comparable BI tools.
* Experience delivering analytics for supply chain, finance, procurement, sales, operations, or HR.
* Experience with end\-to\-end reporting\-platform implementation, migration, or modernization.

**EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage. The successful candidate demonstrates ownership, attention to data accuracy, structured problem solving, collaboration, and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Flight Software Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.


We areseeking a Flight Software Engineer to develop, troubleshoot and maintain our Flight Software. The candidate will be one of the engineers responsible for developing new Flight Software, as well as providing Flight Software support for the Assembly, Integration, Test, Launch and Commissioning of our satellites. This will require the candidate to have an in\-depth knowledge of not only the Flight Software, but also the system as a whole. The candidate will be an integral member of the Flight Software Team, responsible for developing and maintaining all Embedded Flight Software for AST. All Embedded Software development is done in C\+\+ and can also involve hardware interaction for debugging and board bring\-up activities.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Responsible for the design, development, and testing of new embedded software from initial concept to subsystem integration, through full system deployment.
* Incorporate mission\-specific microcontrollers into full systems capable of full spacecraft control.
* Participate in design, code reviews and testing with the team.
* Debug and troubleshoot embedded systems, including system bugs, hardware failures or combability issues.
* Develop and test application\-level software modules that utilize low\-level peripheral drivers when applicable.
* Document and communicate design decisions and progress.
* Collaborate with other sub\-system engineers to define and advance software specifications for development.


**Technical Requirements:**

* At least 5\-7 years of professional experience working with Embedded Programming
* + Ideally with experience in development and support
* Familiar working with a Real\-Time Operating System (RTOS)
* Proficient with C and C\+\+
	+ Comfortable with the C\+\+ 11 (and beyond) standard library
* Experience with multi\-threaded environments
	+ Consideration for concurrency and inter\-process communication
* Familiarity with various protocols such as:
	+ Serial communication protocols (RS\-232, RS\-485, CAN, SPI, etc)
	+ Debugging interfaces (SWD, JTAG)
* Comfortable with development tools/technologies such as:
	+ Oscilloscopes
	+ Logic analyzers
	+ Multimeters
* Familiar with reading and analyzing circuit diagrams and schematics
* Comfortable using version control software, preferably Git
* Familiarity with the command\-line and command\-line tools
* Experience developing software on a Windows PC


**Qualifications**


* Familiar working with ARM microcontrollers
* Familiar with FPGA programming
* Familiar maintaining a large and complex codebase
* Familiar with some scripting language or languages (Python, Ruby, Bash, etc)
* Background in the Aerospace Sector
* Familiar with Matlab/Simulink


**Education:**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering preferred.


**Experience:**


* A minimum of 3\-5 years of professional experience in Embedded Software development.


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with STM32 microcontrollers, including proficiency with IDEs; familiarity with 32\-bit ARM microcontrollers/SoCs; FPGA programming knowledge; experience maintaining a large and complex codebase; scripting language proficiency (Python, Ruby, Bash, etc.); background in the Aerospace Sector; familiarity with Matlab/Simulink.


**Soft Skills:**


* Strong collaboration and cross\-functional teamwork skills; excellent written and verbal communication for documenting design decisions and progress; meticulous attention to detail in software development and testing; ability to work effectively within a team on design and code reviews; proactive in sharing knowledge and coordinating with sub\-system engineers.


**Technology Stack:**


* C, C\+\+ (C\+\+14 and beyond standard library); Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS); STM32 microcontrollers and ARM\-based systems; serial communication protocols (RS\-232, RS\-485, CAN, SPI); debugging interfaces (SWD, JTAG); development tools including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters; Git version control; Windows development environment; FPGA programming tools; Python/Ruby/Bash scripting; Matlab/Simulink.
